title: Mineralisation of Atmospheric Aerosol Particles and Trace Element Analysis by ICP-OES
author: Dufour, Migon
materials: ICP multi-element standard solution VIII CertiPUR®
mono-elemental solutions for V and Ti

steps.title: Prepare sample set
steps.instruction: Organize all natural aerosol and SRM samples into sets of 54, adding two blank filters and two reagent blanks to each set.

steps.title: Weigh reference material
steps.instruction: Weigh 10 mg of NIST 1648 and 1648a onto a filter using a Mettler Toledo XS205 precision balance.

steps.title: Load filters into Teflon bottles
steps.instruction: Fold each filter into quarters and place it into an acid‑cleaned Teflon bottle (60 mL capacity).

steps.title: Add acid digestion mixture
steps.instruction: Add the following acid mixture to each bottle: 1.5 mL HCl (30 % w/w), 0.5 mL HNO₃ (65 % w/w), and 0.5 mL HF (40 % w/w) (aqua regia + HF).

steps.title: Pre‑digestion sonication
steps.instruction: Place the set of bottles in an ultrasonic bath for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Block digestion
steps.instruction: Insert each Teflon bottle into the block digester, seal with a reflux condenser cap, and run the temperature program:

substeps.instruction: Ramp temperature at 2 °C min⁻¹ until reaching 130 °C.

steps.title: Post‑digestion residue treatment
steps.instruction: After cooling, dissolve the residue in 1.5 mL HNO₃ (65 %), sonicate for 15 minutes, then dilute to a final volume of 10 mL with Milli‑Q® water.

steps.title: Store final solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the solution to an acid‑cleaned polypropylene tube (15 mL) and store at 4 °C in a refrigerator until ICP‑OES analysis.
